subject: EU data-location adder and hosted API baseline — quote follow-up
messages:
From: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@nimbleapps.com>
To: vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 21 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Hosted API pricing — EU data-location adder and committed tier question

Hi Vanessa,

Thanks for the demo last week — NimbleApps is moving quickly to lock down hosting assumptions. We have two quick pricing clarifications before we share a formal forecast:

1) Can you confirm Redwood's hosted baseline rate for text generation (per 1k tokens) for Q2 2027?
2) How is the EU "data-location" / residency adder applied — is it a per-token surcharge applied only to requests served from EU-hosted infra, or is it an account-level top-up (single add-on that applies to all tokens when EU residency is enabled)?
3) For committed discounts: do you apply the % discount to the base hosted rate only and then add the residency adder afterward, or is the discount applied to the combined (base + adder) line item?

We expect staging/QA traffic in US (approx 30M tokens/mo) and production traffic split 70% US / 30% EU when full launch occurs. Procurement asked for a draft quote that shows both blended and separated line items so they can model cost.

Attachments: NimbleApps_RFP_v2.pdf (RFP)

Can you send a short breakout? Appreciate a one-page view we can pass to finance.

Best,
Olivia
Head of Platform, NimbleApps
olivia.chen@nimbleapps.com
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@nimbleapps.com>
Cc: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Hosted API pricing — EU data-location adder and committed tier question

Hi Olivia — great to hear from you, and glad the demo was helpful. Quick answers + attached rate card (condensed):

- Baseline hosted generation rate (Q2 2027): $0.040 per 1k tokens (generation). Embeddings are a different line; I included both in the attachment.
- EU data-location option: by default we price the adder as a per-request/per-token surcharge that only applies to tokens served from EU-hosted capacity. Practically that means: if you route a request to EU-hosted regions, those tokens pick up the EU adder.
- Discount application: our standard commercial practice is to apply committed discounts to the base hosted rate first and then add any region-specific adders on top. However, we can offer an alternate blended approach for committed deals (see options below).

Two practical pricing presentations we can provide:
1) Separated model (recommended for finance): base rate after discount + explicit EU adder line (per 1k tokens)
2) Blended model: a single blended per-1k token price reflecting expected regional split and commitment (useful for SOWs/invoices)

Examples (illustrative only):
- No commitment: $0.040 /1k (base) + $0.010 /1k EU adder when served from EU = $0.050 when served from EU.
- With a committed volume discount (see later messages) we can reduce the base to $0.034 /1k, EU adder stays explicit unless you ask for blended pricing.

I attached a compact rate card: Redwood_ratecard_q2_2027.xlsx (pricing lines, tier thresholds, brief terms).

If you can share a 12-month forecast (monthly breakout by region), I can run a blended example and a committed-offer scenario for legal/procurement. Would you prefer a short call tomorrow to walk through the two presentations?

Cheers,
Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai
From: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@nimbleapps.com>

Subject: Re: Hosted API pricing — EU data-location adder and committed tier question

Thanks Vanessa — very helpful. A couple clarifications from procurement:

- Is the EU adder charged per 1k tokens (same unit as base) or is there any component that is per GB (egress/storage)?
- We intend to do marketplace procurement (AWS Marketplace) but need to know whether the adders are supported through the marketplace billing flow or whether they'd appear as a separate direct invoice.
- Are listed amounts net of VAT? We need to model tax.

Forecast (rough):
- Months 1-3 (pilot): 10M tokens/mo (US-only)
- Months 4-12 (ramped): average 80M tokens/mo (total), expected split US 70% / EU 30%

If you can show the two pricing presentations for that ramp we can pass to finance early next week.

Also attaching our procurement checklist.

Best,
Olivia

Hi Olivia — looping in Neha (Pricing Lead) and Marcus (Solutions) and proposing a short MAP so we can get you a clean, trackable quote:

Mutual Action Plan (high level)
- This week: Vanessa to provide separated + blended price tables for the 12-month forecast you shared. (Deliverable: PDF rate table + line-item scenarios)
- Next 3 business days: Technical due diligence call with Marcus to confirm routing/region split and egress assumptions.
- Within 5 business days after TD: Neha to produce committed-offer (term sheet) with negotiated adders and draft SOW.
- Procurement: review SOW and return redlines / approval.

Notes on your questions:
- EU adder is per 1k tokens when requests are served from EU capacity. Egress/storage are separate lines if you use our dedicated on-prem or cross-region transfer (not relevant for standard hosted EU residency).
- Marketplace billing: we can support AWS Marketplace for base usage; region adders can be shown as separate line items depending on marketplace rules — if you need a single invoice we can arrange a direct invoice path under the SOW.
- Tax/VAT: quotes are listed as USD list price (pre-VAT). Net vs gross depends on procurement jurisdiction — we'll include VAT lines in the SOW.

Attaching a draft SOW template that includes billing options and termination windows: NimbleApps_SOW_draft_2027-04.pdf

Marcus — can you propose two slots for a 30-min TD tomorrow or Thursday?

Thanks,
Vanessa
From: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: Hosted API pricing — EU data-location adder and hosted API baseline — quote follow-up

Hi Olivia / team — thanks for the forecast. Based on the ramp you provided, here is a committed-offer we can put in a short term sheet:

Committed commercial offer (draft):
- Term: 12 months, minimum annual commitment = 2.4B tokens (200M tokens/mo average)
- Pricing: 15% off public baseline for the committed volume (applies to base hosted token lines). Public baseline: $0.040/1k -> committed base: $0.034/1k.
- EU data-location adder: standard public adder $0.010/1k; committed-adder (applies to tokens served from EU under this agreement): $0.0075/1k. Adder remains an explicit line on invoices.
- Billing: monthly invoicing; Redwood can support either AWS Marketplace or direct invoicing. If you elect Marketplace, the adder will be shown as a separate line and reconciled monthly.
- Taxes: invoices issued pre-VAT; VAT lines will be added per jurisdiction.
- Early termination: 60 days notice, unused committed tokens are forfeited but we will provide a one-time true-up credit if usage exceeds commitment.

If that looks reasonable I can generate a short term sheet and update the SOW. Key open items for pricing: accepted committed monthly quantity and confirmation of marketplace vs direct invoice.

-Neha Kapoor
